meta.prompt_source: 用户提供题面：英语二图表作文（某高校学生每月参加志愿服务次数占比）

band.rationale: 对照第三档描述：“基本完成了试题规定的任务”——图表三组数据（35%/45%/20%）全部覆盖，描述与评论两项任务均完成；“应用的语法结构和词汇能满足任务的需求”“有一些语法结构或词汇方面的错误，但不影响理解”——percentage 误用、does not provides、主谓不一致、复数缺失等基础错误密集分布于三段，但句句可读懂；“采用简单的衔接手法，内容基本连贯，层次基本清晰”——Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 串联三段式。未达第四档：错误多为基础性失误，而非“试图使用较复杂结构或较高级词汇时才有个别错误”。

dimensions.name: 切题与图表解读
dimensions.evidence: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三组数据与两项任务均覆盖，但图表描述表达系统性失准：percent/percentage 三处误用、take part in one to two times 缺宾语、20 percentage students 缺 of，描述仅机械列举而无概括

dimensions.name: 内容展开与评论
dimensions.evidence: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students. It can help us learn skill and make friend.
dimensions.deduction_reason: 原因段与评论段均单句列举，无任何解释或例证；评论停留在 good for students 的泛化层面，深度不足

dimensions.name: 组织与段落逻辑
dimensions.evidence: the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join
dimensions.deduction_reason: 三段框架清晰（描述—原因—评论），Firstly/Secondly/In my opinion 衔接明确；但第二段逗号粘连破坏句界，第三段建议句用 and 生硬串联

dimensions.name: 语法与句式控制
dimensions.evidence: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities
dimensions.deduction_reason: 基础错误密集且遍布三段：主谓一致（activities is）、助动词后动词形式（does not provides）、可数名词复数（learn skill / make friend）、逗号粘连、the the 重复

dimensions.name: 词汇与搭配
dimensions.evidence: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
dimensions.deduction_reason: percentage 三次误用、phenomonon 拼写错误、make friend / grow up better 搭配失误，词汇面窄且重复（volunteer activities 全篇高频复现）

dimensions.name: 格式与卷面
dimensions.evidence: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.

consistency.adjustments: 初评语法与句式控制拟给 1/2，对照第 4 节扣分锚点第 4 条（基础错误几乎每段都出现）从严下调至 0.5/2；维度和 8.5 落在第三档 7–9 区间内，校验通过。字数 135 为建议下限 150 的 90%（ratio 0.9，soft_ok），按第 4.3 条小幅不足不机械罚分，仅在批改中提示。

sentence_edits.original: The chart shows the situation of students taking part in volunteer activities in a university.
sentence_edits.issue: “the situation of students taking part in”是“学生参加……的情况”的直译，空泛不清；图表作文首句更适合直接点明对象与频次。
sentence_edits.revised: The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities.

sentence_edits.original: 35 percentage of students never join in volunteer activities, while 45 percentage of them take part in one to two times every month.
sentence_edits.issue: 数词后应用 percent（如 35 percent of the students），percentage 是名词“百分比”，不能直接跟在数字后（本篇三处同错）；且 take part in 后缺宾语，不能直接接 one to two times。
sentence_edits.revised: 35 percent of the students never take part in volunteer activities, while 45 percent of them do so one to two times a month.

sentence_edits.original: Only 20 percentage students join three times or more.
sentence_edits.issue: percentage 应为 percent，且 percent 后需加 of 才能接名词；join 后缺宾语，读者需自行补出“参加什么”。
sentence_edits.revised: Only 20 percent of the students take part in such activities three times or more a month.

sentence_edits.original: There are many reasons for this phenomonon.
sentence_edits.issue: phenomonon 拼写错误，正确形式为 phenomenon。
sentence_edits.revised: There are many reasons for this phenomenon.

sentence_edits.original: Firstly, some students think study is more important than volunteer work, so they spend all their time in the library.
sentence_edits.issue: study 泛指“学业”时光杆单数读起来生硬，用 their studies 更自然；不算硬伤，扣分从宽。
sentence_edits.revised: Firstly, some students think their studies are more important than volunteer work, so they spend almost all their time in the library.

sentence_edits.original: Secondly, the school does not provides enough information about volunteer activities, many students don't know how to join.
sentence_edits.issue: does not 后动词须用原形 provide；两个独立分句不能仅用逗号连接（逗号粘连），应加 so 或拆成两句；句末 join 缺宾语。
sentence_edits.revised: Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, so many students don't know how to join them.

sentence_edits.original: In my opinion, volunteer activities is good for students.
sentence_edits.issue: 主语 volunteer activities 为复数，be 动词应用 are。
sentence_edits.revised: In my opinion, volunteer activities are good for students.

sentence_edits.original: It can help us learn skill and make friend.
sentence_edits.issue: skill 与 friend 均为可数名词，泛指时须复数（skills / friends）；指代复数主语 volunteer activities 用 They 更一致。
sentence_edits.revised: They can help us learn skills and make friends.

sentence_edits.original: The school should offer more chances and students should balance the the study and volunteer work.
sentence_edits.issue: the 重复（the the）为笔误；balance 后的 study 前不需冠词，用 their studies 更自然；两个独立分句之间宜加逗号。
sentence_edits.revised: The school should offer more chances, and students should balance their studies and volunteer work.

sentence_edits.original: Only in this way can we grow up better.
sentence_edits.issue: “grow up better”是“更好地成长”的直译；grow up 多指小孩长大，大学生语境用 develop ourselves 或 make progress 更贴切。此处为表达优化建议，不计扣分。
sentence_edits.revised: Only in this way can we develop ourselves better.

improved_version:
The chart shows how often students in a certain university take part in volunteer activities every month. According to the chart, 35 percent of the students never participate in such activities, 45 percent do so only one to two times a month, and merely 20 percent take part three times or more.

Several reasons may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, some students believe that their studies matter more, so they spend almost all their spare time in the library. Secondly, the school does not provide enough information about volunteer activities, and as a result, many students simply do not know how to join them.

In my opinion, volunteer activities benefit students in many ways. They help us learn practical skills and make new friends. Therefore, the school should offer more opportunities while students learn to balance their studies with volunteer work. Only in this way can we truly develop ourselves during college life.
top_problems: 基础语法错误密集且遍布三段：主谓一致（volunteer activities is）、助动词后动词形式（does not provides）、可数名词复数（learn skill / make friend）、逗号粘连与 the the 笔误，直接压住档位上限
图表语言失准：percent/percentage 混用贯穿三处数据描述，take part in one to two times 缺宾语，削弱图表描述的可信度
论证单薄：原因与评论各仅单句列举，无解释或例证；词汇面窄，评论停留在 good for students 的泛化表达
practice_advice: 每天用“数字 + percent of + 对象 + 动词”句型造 3 个图表描述句，写完自检三条：percent 不写成 percentage、does not 后动词用原形、可数名词泛指时加复数，一周即可消除本篇最高频的三类错误。

patterns: The chart shows how often ... take part in ...
According to the chart, X percent of ..., while ...
Several reasons may account for this phenomenon. Firstly, ... Secondly, ...
Only in this way can we ...
words: balance their studies with volunteer work
